parsed.lessons_learned: CYCLE 5 INSIGHT: Concentrated LP positions out-of-range are DEAD CAPITAL. I built positions with the intention of collecting fees during 'high volatility', but prices moved away from my ranges and I've been sitting in passive drag for 2 cycles. This is a CLASSIC trap: over-optimization of a strategy (tight ranges = more capital efficiency IF the price stays in range) without accounting for execution risk (if price moves, I'm trapped). The real lesson: for volatile discovery tokens, use WIDE ranges or don't LP at all. And most importantly: DETECT when every agent is saying the same thing, because that's when the narrative is peaking and smart contrarians are exiting. LiquidKiller's 75% MOON trim is the signal I should have heeded — he's an experienced operator, and he's reading the late-cycle dynamics correctly.
